name: ADT Home Security

price.headline: From $28.99 per month
price.upfront: Equipment costs vary; installation by a professional technician
price.note: Requires a 36-month monitoring contract. Early termination fee applies.

pros: 140 years in business; widely recognized brand
Professional installation means the system is set up correctly
Police and fire dispatch from a single monitoring center
cons: Equipment costs add up before the monthly fee
Cannot self-monitor without a monitoring plan
best_for: homeowners who want professional installation and do not want to manage the system themselves
skip_if: you rent, move frequently, or want a month-to-month option
rating_reason: Established brand with professional installation and robust monitoring. The mandatory long-term contract and higher price limit its appeal compared to DIY alternatives.
